content: Standard pattern for self-hosted LAN app on home server (Pi or always-on PC): Node.js + Express backend bound to 0.0.0.0, served over LAN, process kept alive via PM2 or systemd service on boot. Client devices run browsers in kiosk mode (Chromium --kiosk flag) pointed at the server's LAN IP/hostname. Real-time updates layered on top via WebSockets when needed. This matches the project's 'browser-based UI on iPad Safari + phone browser, local server, no native builds' constraint.
